rulesTestNames: lets administrators and the owner read the list, and no other duty
lists by a query naming the programme, and denies writes
read: get and list (query naming programId) by accounts holding the programme administration duty and the programme owner, while not deleted; coordinators hold every duty but programAdmin and read nothing here
write: server only; written from programStaffGrants and organizerPrograms
migrationNotes: Exactly the member row the retired listProgramStaff callable returned, with its clock-dependent status replaced by the facts it derives from (revoked, owner approval, when live duties start and end). Display names and the last four phone digits are personal data scrubbed with the grant by archive anonymization, which reaches the rows through the grant trigger. The program-staff-views copy-forward migration creates rows for grants that predate the triggers and leaves rows the triggers wrote alone.
